record.field: Site Link: calls from a linked site

The technical user whose API key a linked site uses. Its calls (health, part lookup, part consumption, customers, repair quotes and invoices, single sign-on tickets) run with the rights they need, nothing more: the user needs no other access.
A linked site may sign these users in here with a one-time link (valid 60 seconds, used once). Only active internal users; never the superuser or the admin user (ids 1 and 2).
